response.sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) IS NOT NULL), ov AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM pr), g1 AS (SELECT pr.ID, pr.ratio, pr.ratio - ov.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM pr, ov WHERE pr.ratio > ov.overall_avg), ga AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM g1), g2 AS (SELECT g1.ID, g1.ratio, g1.above_overall, g1.ratio - ga.group_avg AS above_group FROM g1, ga WHERE g1.ratio > ga.group_avg) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(above_group) AS avg_above_group FROM g2
